name: editor

frames.best_why: Editor content plus the selection toolbar with its Format dropdown open, showing the formatting options.

tagline: Rich text editor with a selection toolbar and task-list content.
summary: A rich text editor showing a launch-plan document with headings, bold and italic text, a checklist and a quote. Selecting text raises a floating toolbar with block, format and link controls, plus a word count.
appearance: A dark rounded card holds a document: a bold heading, a paragraph with bold and italic runs, a checked task list with square checkboxes, a left-bordered quote and a line of names. A word count sits in the bottom-right corner, and selection shows a rounded floating toolbar above the text.
behaviour: Typing slash on a new line opens a command list for blocks; selecting text pops a floating toolbar with Text, Format and Link menus. Choosing Bold, a heading or a list restyles the selection in place, checkboxes toggle, and the corner word count updates.
demo_content: A 'Launch plan: Billing v2' note with billing copy, a three-item checklist, and 'Owner: Maya Chen'.
search_phrases: format text with a popup toolbar
task list with checkboxes and quotes
select text to make it bold
use_when: A product needs an in-page document editor with block commands, inline formatting and checklists, not a plain textarea.
avoid_when: It pulls in a large Tiptap stack and several shared UI parts, so a simple comment box should use a lighter input.
customise: Content comes as HTML or JSON plus a placeholder and character limit; which toolbar items appear is decided by which subcomponents you nest, and colours follow the theme.
weight_why: A full Tiptap stack with tables, syntax highlighting and menus adds a large bundle.

a11y.note: The editor and slash menu work from the keyboard, but many icon-only toolbar buttons rely on tooltips instead of labels, and reduced motion is ignored.

issues: The floating toolbar covers the line it is formatting, hiding nearby text.
Many toolbar buttons are icon-only with no visible text label.
polish_why: Clean, feature-rich editor; menus crowd the text they format and icons are unlabelled.
title: Editor
